notes: masks.py: alpha_over (premultiplied over operator per para2.5), build_mask_alpha (all 5 growth kinds: perspective/radius/gradient/displaced_edge/matte_seq; all 3 anchors: world/screen/layer-plane), composite_with_mask (F=D*M+S*(1-M) + L2 in-front-of-mask rule). Near-cull handoff: when cull_opacity<0.001 returns ones. cv2 copied from miniforge3 (abi3 binary, compatible with Python 3.11). All buffers float32. No pixel loops — all vectorized. scipy not needed (cv2.GaussianBlur used for feathering, numpy for polygon fill via cv2.fillPoly).
